_doc: Mondlicht's zone ambience (UPDATE 09 s5.5, T-149) for ZoneAmbience: one bed per zone (an audio.json key from gravelight/tools_src/gen_audio_moon.py, synthesized, Owned), crossfaded on zone change, and the zone's one-shots at random intervals. `vacuum: true` marks a zone with no air: the bed is the suit only (breath, fan, regulator) and nothing outside is heard (the T-112 suit low-pass stays on the SFX and Ambience buses); its one-shots are suit sounds only.
